signature.name: VTask.affineCombination
signature.type: (k : Type u_1) -> {V : Type u_2} -> {P : Type u_3} -> [Ring k] -> [AddCommGroup V] -> [Module k V] -> [S : AddTorsor V P] -> {ι : Type u_4} -> (s : Finset ι) -> (p : ι → P) -> (ι → k) →ᵃ[k] P

conventions.statement: When `s = ∅`, `VTask.affineCombination s p w` equals the internally chosen base point of the torsor for every weight function `w`.
conventions.note: The base point is a classical choice from the nonempty torsor; no geometric meaning is attached to the empty combination.

conventions.statement: The map `VTask.affineCombination s p` is defined for all weight functions; the barycentric interpretation (convex/affine combination) is only valid and invoked in lemmas that carry an explicit `∑ i in s, w i = 1` hypothesis.
conventions.note: This is a deliberate design choice: the definition is total, and barycentricity is opt-in via hypotheses.

conventions.statement: The internal base point used in the computation is chosen classically from the torsor and does not affect the value of the affine map for any weight function.
conventions.note: Two different classical choices yield the same affine map; the construction is canonical even though an arbitrary element is used internally.

facts.statement: ∀ (k : Type*) (V : Type*) (P : Type*) (ι : Type*) [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] (s : Finset ι) (p : ι → P) (w₁ w₂ : ι → k), VTask.affineCombination k s p w₁ -ᵥ VTask.affineCombination k s p w₂ = Finset.weightedVSub s p (w₁ - w₂)

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∃ (ι : Type) (s : Finset ι) (p : ι → ℝ) (w : ι → ℝ), VTask.affineCombination ℝ s p w ≠ (Finset.weightedVSub s p w : ℝ)
